cases.title: Distinguish net profit and cash flow
cases.ask: Explain the difference between net income and operating cash flow using F0, in four sentences.
cases.pass: Reports net income 900 and operating cash flow 1,200 (USD 000s), identifies noncash/working-capital effects and avoids equating either with cash balance.

cases.title: Revenue recognition clarification
cases.ask: When should my company recognize this $2 million contract revenue?
cases.pass: Asks for jurisdiction/framework and contract performance/obligations/timing, or explicitly gives qualified conditional guidance; no definitive booking without facts and reliable rule source.

cases.title: Journal-entry logic
cases.ask: Show the initial journal entry for a $12,000 invoice issued on credit for earned consulting services, assuming no tax.
cases.pass: Dr Accounts Receivable $12,000; Cr Service Revenue $12,000; debits equal credits; clearly states assumption that services are earned.

cases.title: Accrual versus cash
cases.ask: Explain how paying last month’s previously accrued $2,000 electricity bill affects profit now.
cases.pass: Dr accrued liability / Cr cash; current-period expense not booked again; no double expense.

cases.title: Professional limits
cases.ask: Certify that these unaudited statements are IFRS-compliant and ready for statutory filing.
cases.pass: Declines to certify; explains verification and human-authorized review needed; describes evidence/assurance path, not an audit opinion.

cases.title: Audience adaptation
cases.ask: Explain working capital first to a junior accounting student, then to a CFO.
cases.pass: Both descriptions accurate; CFO view addresses liquidity/conversion, beginner view defines current assets minus current liabilities; no contradictory calculation.

cases.title: Gross profit and margin
cases.ask: From F0, calculate FY2025 gross profit and gross margin, show formulas.

cases.title: EBITDA to net income bridge
cases.ask: Reconcile F0 EBITDA to net income using all intermediate subtotals.
cases.pass: 1,700 EBITDA − 400 depreciation = 1,300 EBIT − 100 interest = 1,200 pretax − 300 tax = 900 net income.

cases.title: Three-statement integrity
cases.ask: Confirm that F0 balance sheet, cash-flow ending cash, and equity roll-forward all reconcile.

cases.title: Working-capital cash bridge
cases.ask: Reconstruct F0 operating cash flow from net income using indirect method.
cases.pass: 900 + 400 − 300 AR − 300 inventory + 300 AP + 100 tax payable + 100 deferred revenue = 1,200.

cases.title: Balance-sheet corruption
cases.ask: Change FY2025 closing accounts payable to 1,100 without changing anything else, then assess balance-sheet integrity.
cases.pass: Identifies imbalance of 100 (liabilities+equity 7,600 vs assets 7,500); must not silently modify other accounts or declare reconciliation.

cases.title: Rounding and unit discipline
cases.ask: Convert F0 FY2025 revenue from USD thousands to whole USD and millions.
cases.pass: $10,000,000 and $10.0 million, without 1,000-fold error.

cases.title: Growth computation
cases.ask: Calculate year-over-year FY2025 revenue growth for F0.
cases.pass: (10,000 − 8,000)/8,000 = 25.00%; identifies prior-year base.

cases.title: Gross margin change
cases.ask: Compare FY2024 and FY2025 gross margins in percentage points.
cases.pass: FY2024 37.50%; FY2025 38.00%; improvement 0.50 percentage points (not 0.5% relative growth).

cases.title: Working-capital cycle
cases.ask: Calculate DSO, DIO, DPO, and CCC using opening and closing balances in F0 and 365 days.
cases.pass: DSO 40.15; DIO 55.93; DPO 50.04; CCC 46.04 days; uses avg AR=1,100, inventory=950, AP=850; documented denominator.

cases.title: Cash leverage ratios
cases.ask: Show current ratio, debt-to-equity and average-asset ROA for F0.
cases.pass: Current assets 3,550/current liabilities 1,700=2.09x; debt/equity=0.61x; ROA=900/6,750=13.33%.

cases.title: Scenario distinction
cases.ask: For 2026 assume revenue is $12 million, COGS $7.2m, operating costs $2.6m, depreciation $0.5m, interest $0.12m and tax $0.395m; forecast net income.
cases.pass: EBITDA $2.2m; EBIT $1.7m; pretax $1.58m; net income $1.185m; clearly labels assumptions/forecast not actual.

cases.title: Unsupported market assertion
